The report alone does not establish that the sampled PC was executing throughout the stall.

The host snapshot spans 2026-09-19T14:12:23.503568Z through14:12:25.515585Z (2.012019435 host-monotonic seconds). The two dominant execution threads are likely the two TCG vCPU threads, but their generic names do not prove which guest CPU each runs. Do not label them CPU0/CPU1 without an explicit mapping.

The first thread had stat=R, wchan=futex_do_wait and syscall=running in the first sample; these sequential reads are not atomic and must not be interpreted as one persistent contradictory state.
